description: Mark all unread messages in a folder as read. Optionally limit to messages older than a given date. Pass `dryRun: true` to preview the affected count without flipping any flags.

dryRun.description: Preview the count of unread messages that would be marked, without flipping any flags.

folder.description: Folder to mark as read (default: INBOX)

olderThan.description: Only mark messages before this date as read (YYYY-MM-DD, exclusive — messages strictly before this date)

name: mark_all_read
